dashboard.title: Monitors
dashboard.subtitle: {up} up · {down} down · {paused} paused
dashboard.emptyHint: Create your first monitor to start collecting heartbeats.
dashboard.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, description or tag
dashboard.degradedWarning: One or more cluster nodes are unavailable; the votes of the missing nodes are excluded.

monitor.retriesHelp: How many extra attempts before the monitor is considered down.
monitor.resendHelp: 0 notifies only when the status changes. A positive value repeats the alert while the monitor stays down.
monitor.timeoutHelp: Maximum duration of a single check.
monitor.upsideDownHelp: The monitor is up when the target is unreachable (for example a firewall rule that must keep blocking).
monitor.runOnHelp: Which cluster nodes execute this check. Every node votes and the failure strategy decides the final status.
monitor.acceptedCodesHelp: Ranges and codes separated by commas, for example 200-299,301.
monitor.keywordPlaceholder: Text that must appear in the response
monitor.tcpHelp: The monitor connects, optionally sends the payload and validates the answer.
monitor.dnsInvertHelp: With an expected value: up when the value is absent. Without a value: up when the name does not resolve.
monitor.deleteWarning: The monitor and all of its heartbeats will be removed. This cannot be undone.
monitor.pauseWarning: Pausing stops the checks until you resume the monitor.

notifications.title: Notification channels
notifications.subtitle: Alerts delivered when a monitor changes status
notifications.emptyHint: Create an SMTP or Webhook channel to receive alerts.
notifications.webhookBodyHelp: Go template with the alert variables, for example {'{{'}.Event{'}}'} or {'{{'}.MonitorName{'}}'}. Leave it empty to use the default JSON body.
notifications.webhookHeadersHelp: Sent with every request: use it for an Authorization token or a signature header.
notifications.linkedMonitorsHelp: Without any link the channel receives no alerts.
notifications.deleteWarning: The channel will be removed from every monitor.

statusPages.title: Status pages
statusPages.subtitle: Public read-only pages you can share with your users
statusPages.emptyHint: Create a public page and pick the monitors to display.
statusPages.isPublicHelp: Disabled: only authenticated administrators can preview the page.
statusPages.selectMonitorsHelp: The list order defines the display order.
statusPages.badgeHelp: SVG badge ready to be embedded in a README.
statusPages.deleteWarning: The public page stops responding immediately.

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Public API tokens and the IP allow/deny list
security.tokensHelp: Used in the Authorization: Bearer <token> header of /api/v1.
security.tokenCreated: Copy the token now: it will not be shown again.
security.ipRulesHelp: With no rule everything is allowed. As soon as an allow rule exists the scope becomes an allow list.
security.bypassWarning: IP rules are disabled because SECURITY_BYPASS_IP_RULES=true.
security.lockoutWarning: Careful: denying your own address on the Everything scope locks you out of the dashboard. Use the database or SECURITY_BYPASS_IP_RULES to recover.

cluster.title: Cluster
cluster.subtitle: Several dashboards synchronised through the same database
cluster.disabledHint: Set CLUSTER_ENABLED=true on this node to join a cluster.
cluster.privateKeyHelp: Share this key with the other nodes when they join. It lives in the shared settings table.
cluster.regenerateWarning: Every node must join again with the new key.
cluster.joinHelp: Provide the primary node URL and the cluster private key.
cluster.failureAnyHelp: The monitor goes down as soon as one node reports a failure.
cluster.failureAllHelp: The monitor goes down only when every online node fails.
cluster.failureQuorumHelp: The monitor goes down when the majority fails; a partial failure shows as degraded.
cluster.nodeUnavailableHelp: Nodes without a heartbeat for more than 2 minutes stop voting. With MARK_DEGRADED their absence is surfaced as a warning.
cluster.notificationSenderHelp: ANY_WITH_LOCK uses a database lock to avoid duplicated notifications.

settings.subtitle: Locale and theme defaults for new visitors
settings.defaultsHelp: Applied only to visitors who have not chosen a language or theme in their browser yet.
